Method of Attack: Starts a hidden local HTTP server on port 59777 that remains open in the background
Allows attacker on same local network to obtain device info, list and download files, and remotely launch apps
Man-In-The-Middle (MitM) attack to intercept and manipulate HTTP network traffic
Impacted Systems: Android devices running ES File Explorer
Attack Vector: Local network access (Wi-Fi) to the always-on HTTP server
MitM attack on app's HTTP traffic
